veranderings.blok: Vuil lug, vuil water en vuil grond
veranderings.voor: Rook uit voertuie en uit vullis wat brand maak die lug vuil.
veranderings.na: Rook uit voertuie en uit vullis wat brand, maak die lug vuil.
veranderings.rede: A comma closing the relative clause stops 'brand maak' being read together, and matches the lesson's own 'Rommel wat lê, trek' pattern.

veranderings.blok: Vullis wat lê waar dit nie hoort nie
veranderings.voor: waar vullis beland waar dit nie hoort nie
veranderings.na: waar vullis beland wat nie daar hoort nie
veranderings.rede: Avoids the clumsy 'waar ... waar' repetition without changing the meaning or the length.

veranderings.blok: Vuil water kan 'n mens maagsiek maak
veranderings.voor: lyk soms skoon en is dit tog nie
veranderings.na: lyk soms skoon maar is dit tog nie
veranderings.rede: The sentence is a contrast, so 'maar' is the natural joiner; no comma because the second half shares the subject.
Litter that is left lying about 'lê rond'; bare 'wat lê' sounds unfinished.
'Uitbroei' means to hatch; mosquitoes breed ('broei') in standing water.

veranderings.voor: Die rook uit 'n groot fabriek is nie jou werk om reg te maak nie.
veranderings.na: Om die rook uit 'n groot fabriek reg te maak, is nie jou werk nie.
veranderings.rede: As written the smoke itself is 'not your job'; fronting the infinitive makes the fixing the subject, at the cost of one word.

veranderings.voor: Wat jy self kan doen is klein maar dit maak
veranderings.na: Wat jy self kan doen, is klein, maar dit maak
veranderings.rede: A comma closes the subject clause before 'is', and AWS requires one before 'maar' since 'dit maak' is a second clause with its own subject and verb.

veranderings.blok: Dinge wat jy elke dag kan doen
veranderings.voor: Maak kompos van skille en blare, en spaar
veranderings.na: Maak kompos van skille en blare en spaar
veranderings.rede: Two commands with no stated subject take no comma before 'en' under AWS 2017.
A named national observance takes no indefinite article.

veranderings.voor: Dit was eers net een dag en dit is later
veranderings.na: Dit was eers net een dag en is later
veranderings.rede: As written it needs an AWS comma before 'en'; dropping the repeated 'dit' gives one subject, so no comma is needed and the sentence is shorter.
'Skoolgrond' reads as the soil; the school's premises are 'die skoolterrein', and a tree is planted 'op' them.
'Dood staan' is not idiomatic Afrikaans; the verb is 'doodgaan' (see also the flag on this sentence).

veranderings.voor: 'n Boom gooi skaduwee en dit bly
veranderings.na: 'n Boom gooi skaduwee, en dit bly
veranderings.rede: Two clauses each with their own subject and verb ('Boom gooi', 'dit bly') take a comma before 'en' under AWS 2017.
After a noun of time the relative is 'waarop', not 'wanneer'.

veranderings.voor: Om ou goed te gebruik om iets nuuts van te maak.
veranderings.na: Om iets nuuts van ou goed te maak.
veranderings.rede: Removes the stranded 'van' and the double 'om ... om' with the same meaning, and is shorter.

vlae.teks: Die deel van die lug wat lewende dinge moet inasem.
vlae.rede: The protected entry for 'suurstof' says fish and most water animals use no air at all; a definition saying all living things must breathe in air may state that error. Content question, not a language one, so not changed.

vlae.teks: 'n Boom wat niemand natmaak nie, is 'n dag se werk wat later dood staan.
vlae.rede: Even with 'doodgaan' the sentence says a day's work dies; the intended point (the tree dies and the day's work is lost) cannot be rephrased cleanly without guessing the wording the writer wants, and the text is at its ceiling.
